basis: Renal bicarbonate wasting causes acidosis; reduced bone density occurred in 2/2 studied affected brothers, with limited sampling.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: reduced bone density in 2/2 affected brothers supports direct skeletal involvement. [Study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10972690/).

basis: Joubert brain malformations define disease; hand/foot polydactyly reported in 1/1 patient. Hypermetropia alone does not establish ocular injury.

decisions.ocular: none: hypermetropia in 1/1 patient does not demonstrate ocular tissue injury or significant visual loss; nystagmus can reflect the cerebellar disorder.

basis: Familial rhabdoid tumors characteristically originate in CNS and kidney. [NCI](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK602739/).

decisions.renal: primary: kidney is a characteristic origin of the familial rhabdoid tumors defining this concept; this is a tumor-site label, not secondary renal damage.

basis: ERBIN immune dysregulation includes chronic eczema; >30% is inferred from sparse familial reports. Additional organ injury frequencies are unestablished.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: chronic eczema is a recurrent core phenotype, inferred >30% from sparse reports. [NIH](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/RCV001984044.6/).

basis: Familial cirrhosis establishes hepatic fibrosis; supplied evidence does not identify the antigen or establish a viral or immune-mediated cause.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: antigenemia is unspecified; the supplied definition and ancestry do not establish hepatitis B infection or an immune mechanism.

basis: FOXN1 deficiency is defined by severe T-cell deficiency, congenital alopecia and nail dystrophy; reduced circulating T-cell counts occur in 80-99%.

decisions.haematologic: primary: defining deficiency of circulating T cells is a blood-cell disorder; decreased total T-cell count occurs in 80-99%.

basis: Systemic viral infection; HPO supports hepatocellular injury at 80-99%, kidney injury and bleeding dysfunction at 30-79%. Neurologic injury and shock are occasional.

decisions.haematologic: involved: abnormal bleeding and excessive bleeding after venipuncture are frequent (30-79%), supporting common haemostatic dysfunction despite lower frequencies of specific laboratory defects.
decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatocellular injury is very frequent (ALT elevation 80-99%); hepatic disease is organ involvement of the systemic infection rather than its defining primary location.

basis: Prostatic hyperplasia affects a reproductive organ. Urinary symptoms or outflow obstruction do not establish direct urinary-tract injury in at least 30%.

decisions.renal: none: prostate has no axis; urinary symptoms alone do not demonstrate urinary-tract damage. Retention, bladder injury and obstructive nephropathy are not established in >=30%.

basis: Respiratory ciliary dysfunction; persistent hearing loss affects ~30% in PCD cohorts, with chronic middle-ear dysfunction much more frequent; subtype data sparse.

decisions.otologic: involved: persistent hearing loss ~30% in PCD, from chronic middle-ear dysfunction; subtype extrapolation. [Cohort](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11843728/).

basis: Photosensitive dermatosis and antibody deficiency define syndrome. Insulin resistance lacks established injury; diabetes/ovarian insufficiency are separate diagnoses; steatosis is a single report.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: insulin resistance (30-79%) alone does not establish organ injury; diabetes and premature ovarian insufficiency are separately diagnosed conditions.
